questions.question: Who among the following received the Padma shri award in 2025 in the category of ‘Others–Spiritualism’ Posthumously?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lama Lobzang**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Lama Lobzang was **posthumously **honored with the **Padma Shri **award in **2025 **in the category of '**Others–Spiritualism**'.
 
• The Padma Shri is the fourth highest civilian award in India, recognizing distinguished contributions in various fields.
 
• Lama Lobzang was a prominent figure in the field of spiritualism and contributed significantly to the promotion of Buddhist teachings and practices.
 
• His work emphasized peace, harmony, and the preservation of Buddhist cultural heritage in India and beyond.
 
• The award highlights his lifelong dedication to spiritual and cultural enrichment in society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Awards**

 
 
• Established in 1954, the Padma Awards include** Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri**.
 
• These awards are announced annually on the eve of Republic Day and honor individuals for their exceptional contributions.
 
• Fields covered include art, literature, science, social work, public affairs, and more.
 
 
 
• **Spiritualism in India**
 
 
• India has a rich history of spiritualism that spans diverse traditions like Hinduism, Buddhism, Jainism, and Sufism.
 
• Spiritual leaders often play a key role in fostering societal harmony and addressing ethical challenges.
 
 
 
• **Buddhism and Lama Tradition**
 
 
• The Lama tradition is integral to Tibetan Buddhism, emphasizing meditation, rituals, and teachings to attain spiritual enlightenment.
 
• India is home to significant Buddhist heritage sites, including Bodh Gaya and Sarnath.
 
 
 
• **Posthumous Awards**
 
 
• Posthumous awards are given to honor individuals who have made significant contributions during their lifetime.
 
• Such recognition ensures that their legacy continues to inspire future generations.

• Capital: Brasília
 
• Official language: Portuguese
 
• President: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva
 
• Continent: South America

questions.question: In 2025, which state launched a groundbreaking initiative aimed at eradicating mother to-child transmission of HIV, syphilis, and Hepatitis B by 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In 2025, the state of **West Bengal** launched an innovative program aimed at eradicating mother-to-child transmission of HIV, syphilis, and Hepatitis B by the year 2026.
 
• This initiative aligns with global efforts under the **World Health Organization’s (WHO) elimination strategy** for these diseases.
 
• West Bengal became the **first state in India** to implement such a comprehensive program focusing on maternal and child health.
 
• The program includes widespread testing, awareness campaigns, and free treatment for affected mothers to ensure the health of newborns.
 
• Specialized healthcare facilities were set up in collaboration with national and international health organizations to support this initiative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mother-to-Child Transmission (MTCT):**

 
 
• MTCT refers to the transmission of diseases such as HIV, syphilis, or Hepatitis B from an infected mother to her child during pregnancy, childbirth, or breastfeeding.
 
• It is a major public health issue, especially in low- and middle-income countries.
 
 
 
• **HIV Elimination Efforts:**
 
 
• The **UNAIDS 95-95-95 targets** aim to ensure that 95% of people with HIV know their status, 95% are on treatment, and 95% achieve viral suppression by 2030.
 
• India has been actively working to reduce HIV prevalence through initiatives like the National AIDS Control Program.
 
 
 
• **Syphilis Testing and Treatment:**
 
 
• Early detection and treatment of syphilis during pregnancy can prevent congenital syphilis, which can lead to severe complications in newborns.
 
• Penicillin remains the most effective treatment for syphilis.
 
 
 
• **Hepatitis B Prevention:**
 
 
• Hepatitis B vaccines are highly effective in preventing transmission and are recommended for all newborns within 24 hours of birth.
 
• India’s Universal Immunization Program includes free Hepatitis B vaccination for children.

questions.question: Who won the 2025 United Nations Population Award in the individual category?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Varsha Deshpande**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Varsha Deshpande honoured with 2025 U.N. Population Award for advancing gender equality.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Varsha Deshpande**, a renowned **women’s rights activist**, won the **2025 United Nations Population Award** in the **individual category**.

 
 
• 
 
Recognised for **35+ years** of work promoting **gender equality** and **reproductive rights**.

 
 
• 
 
She is the **secretary** of **Dalit Mahila Vikas Mandal**, based in **Maharashtra**.

 
 
• 
 
Honoured for fighting **gender-based violence**, **discrimination**, and **sex-selective practices**.

 
 
• 
 
She founded her organization in **1990**, focusing on **legal reform**, **education**, and **grassroots mobilisation**.

 
 
• 
 
The **UN Population Award**, established in **1981** and first awarded in **1983**, honours exceptional contributions in **population and reproductive health**.

 
 
• 
 
The award includes a **gold medal**, a **diploma**, and a **cash prize**.

 
 
• 
 
The 2025 award announcement was made in **New York**, marking the **40th edition** of the prize.

questions.question: What is the 2025 theme for World Population Day?

questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Empowering young people to create the families they want in a fair and hopeful world**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

questions.question: In which military exercise did India participate for the first time in 2025?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Talisman Sabre**__.

India has participated for the first time in **Exercise Talisman Sabre**, Australia’s largest bilateral military drill.

 
 
• 
 
The exercise was launched in **2005** as a **biennial** joint military exercise between the **United States and Australia**.

 
 
•

questions.question: Which Indian state launched the first Tribal Genome Sequencing Project?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Gujarat launches India’s first tribal genome project to tackle inherited diseases.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
Gujarat is the first Indian state to launch a Tribal Genome Sequencing Project.

 
 
• 
 
The goal is to enhance healthcare for tribal communities using genetic research.

 
 
• 
 
It targets early detection of hereditary diseases like sickle cell anaemia and thalassemia.

 
 
• 
 
The Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre (GBRC) is leading the project.

 
 
• 
 
2,000 tribal individuals will have their genomes sequenced.

 
 
• 
 
The data will be used to build a reference genome database.

 
 
• 
 
This initiative supports the development of personalised medicine.

 
 
• 
 
It will also enable more effective, targeted treatments for tribal populations.

questions.question: Who won the 2025 Wimbledon women’s doubles title?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Elise Mertens and Veronika Kudermetova**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Kudermetova and Mertens win Wimbledon women’s doubles title 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Veronika Kudermetova** (Russia) and **Elise Mertens** (Belgium) won the **Wimbledon 2025 women’s doubles title**.

 
 
• 
 
They defeated **Hsieh Su-Wei** and **Jelena Ostapenko**: **3-6, 6-2, 6-4**.

 
 
• 
 
It is **Kudermetova’s first Grand Slam title**.

 
 
• 
 
It is **Mertens’ 2nd Wimbledon title** and **5th Grand Slam doubles title** overall.

 
 
• 
 
Kudermetova lost the **2021 Wimbledon final** to Mertens and Hsieh.

 
 
• 
 
Mertens also reached **4th round in Wimbledon singles 2024**.

 
 
• 
 
**Hsieh** is a veteran with **7 major doubles titles**, including **4 Wimbledons**.
